comment: D1 Lane C scan / call-out mutation kit (S-3; DI-649..656, 0056). Run with tests/kits/d1-scan-mutants.mjs. `red` is the per-suite red count observed when the table was recorded; `equivalent` names a mutant that survives on purpose, with its reason. Recorded 2026-10-08 on feat/d1-scan: 42 run, 42 RED, 0 survivors; then B1 and G-completion-leaks-pick (the blind-rule visibility bypasses) added, both RED: 44 of 44 (the first run left eight survivors S2, S7, S8, S12, C1, K2, E1, E2; the scan twin's sections 7b and 12b were written to kill them). Re-recorded 2026-10-14 after reviewer BLOCK 1/2 (Q1-Q4, X1-X3, N1, D1 added): 49 run, 49 RED, every mutant outside js/scribe-callout.js (C1-C6 not run that day: the scribe agent's uncommitted edits to that file). 2026-10-14, after the scribe pools (e0a8b5f6) and the heat / sentence fixes: C1-C8 run, 8 RED, no stale target.

mutants.what: the scan runs without the x-cfbp-job check
the per-league lease is ignored (two ticks run the same league at once)
mutants.old: if (!lease || lease.reserved !== true) return { envelope: envelopeSkipped(runId, SKIPPED.THROTTLED, { what: 'lease' }), status: 200 };

mutants.what: people who have FINISHED are named (the yes/no is ignored)
guests and unlinked or inactive rows are named (real-member filter gone)
VISIBILITY BYPASS: the call-out reads picks and threads the selected teams into its body
mutants.new: body: capMessageBody(line.body + ' ' + ((((await sb.from('picks').select('selected_team').eq('league_id', leagueId).limit(2)).data) || []).map((p) => p.selected_team).join(','))), notify: false,

mutants.what: the re-read before the insert no longer stops a post when everyone finished
the re-read result is not applied (someone who just finished is still named)
the per-lock occasion ceiling is ignored
mutants.old: if (!calloutOccasionAllowed({ moment: step.moment, ceiling, priorOccasions: prior.length })) return { outcome: 'ceiling', suppressed: true };

mutants.what: the 20-minute gap between call-outs is ignored
mutants.old: if (nowMs - Date.parse(last.ts) < CALLOUT_MIN_GAP_MS) return { outcome: 'spacing', suppressed: true };

mutants.what: a second call-out no longer waits for a human voice in between
a participation hard line no longer keeps a member unnamed
the call-out pushes phones (notify true)
the ceiling read drops its relayed filter (ten newer member-relayed look-alikes crowd SCRIBE's real occasion out of the limit-10 read)
Security F-1: the pipeline's never-two-in-a-row read drops its relayed filter (sixty newer member-relayed rows crowd SCRIBE's last post out of the window)
Security F-1: the call-out's never-two-in-a-row read drops its relayed filter (the same crowding)
the final moment may exceed the ceiling (< becomes <=)
mutants.old: return moment === 'final' ? used < cap : used < cap - 1;
mutants.new: return moment === 'final' ? used <= cap : used < cap - 1;

mutants.what: the ten-minute cutoff before lock is gone
mutants.old: if (now >= L - CALLOUT_CUTOFF_MS) return { moment: null, reason: 'too_late' };
mutants.new: if (now >= L) return { moment: null, reason: 'too_late' };

mutants.what: the post id keeps the league uuid as written (uppercase escapes 0045 reservation)
a guest counts as a real member
the switch reads a truthy value (string "true") as on
mutants.old: return jobs.scribeCallout === true && s.scribeAutonomousEnabled !== false && s.chatEnabled !== false;

mutants.what: a member with a participation hard line is named
the heat is read from the first names shown, not everyone who could be named (a capped member outside them lifts the line to No Mercy)
the two-sentence budget is counted on the rendered body again (a name like "J.R. Smith" drops the line to count-only)
reminders still posts its locking-soon room line while the call-out owns it
the per-event ticket lasts 30 minutes instead of 24 hours
the pipeline no longer refuses scan-only triggers on the client path
the handler no longer refuses scan-only triggers before its service-role work
the chat-silence verifier counts a member-relayed row as another member speaking (relayed filter gone)
